# LumaText source snapshot

Updated from the current sibling LumaText working tree on 2026-09-20 together with deps/lumatext SDK. The prior font-fragment ownership patch is included upstream. The previous snapshot is preserved under build/lumatext-source-before-sdk-update. Application builds use deps/lumatext; scripts/build-lumatext.bat defaults to the current sibling source, not an older snapshot.
